races.title: 2026 FOSS United Governing Board Elections
races.description:
This election season, you are voting to elect three new members to the FOSS United Governing Board. These are the people who’ll help shape the Foundation’s direction and hold it accountable to the community! 

Take a few minutes to read the nominations on the forum if you haven’t already: https://forum.fossunited.org/c/2026-elections/55

How to vote: 
Rate each candidate on the scale below; the three STAR Voting winners will be elected to a 2-year term.
